assignments.name: Set_Baseline_Value
assignments.description: Sets Baseline_Value__c on the triggering record to the Measured_Value__c from the earliest D6 commissioning first passing record retrieved by Get_Baseline_Record
assignments.label: Set Baseline Value

assignments.name: Set_Previous_Value
assignments.description: Sets Previous_Measured_Value__c on the triggering record to the Measured_Value__c from the most recent prior record retrieved by Get_Previous_Record, enabling delta calculation
assignments.label: Set Previous Value

assignments.name: Calculate_And_Set_Delta
assignments.description: Calculates and sets Delta_From_Previous__c on the triggering record by subtracting Previous_Measured_Value__c from Measured_Value__c using the Calculate_Delta_From_Previous formula resource
assignments.label: Calculate And Set Delta

assignments.name: Calculate_And_Set_Drift
assignments.description: Calculates and sets Drift_From_Baseline__c on the triggering record by computing the percentage drift from baseline using the Calculate_Drift_From_Baseline formula resource, only when baseline is valid and non-zero
assignments.label: Calculate And Set Drift

decisions.name: Check_Baseline_Valid_For_Drift
decisions.description: Evaluates if Baseline_Value__c is not null and not equal to zero to ensure drift calculation can proceed safely without division by zero errors

rules.name: Baseline_Valid
rules.description: True when Baseline_Value__c is not null and not equal to zero, allowing safe drift calculation
rules.label: Baseline Valid

decisions.label: Check Baseline Valid For Drift

formulas.name: Calculate_Delta_From_Previous
formulas.description: Calculates the delta (difference) between the current Measured_Value__c and the Previous_Measured_Value__c on the triggering WorkOrderLineItem record by subtracting the previous value from the current value

formulas.name: Calculate_Drift_From_Baseline
formulas.description: Calculates the percentage drift from baseline by computing ((Measured_Value__c - Baseline_Value__c) / Baseline_Value__c) * 100 to determine how much the current measurement has drifted from the original commissioning baseline value

recordLookups.description: Retrieves the earliest D6 commissioning first passing record (Line_Item_Role__c = '시험' and Judgement__c = '합격') for the same Asset and Measurement_Item_Code__c to establish the baseline value, ordered by CreatedDate ascending
recordLookups.label: Get Baseline Record
recordLookups.name: Get_Baseline_Record

recordLookups.description: Retrieves the most recent prior WorkOrderLineItem record for the same Asset and Measurement_Item_Code__c where Measured_Value__c is not null, excluding the triggering record, ordered by CreatedDate descending to find the last existing measured value
recordLookups.label: Get Previous Record
recordLookups.name: Get_Previous_Record
